about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_search.py). bad replays the websearch class failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real busy, shape, or timeout line. good waits with a backoff, narrows the query, guards the shape, bounds the wait, and prints the retry report it promises.

fixture.query.txt: broad query about owner name with many words and a wide scope

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp)'
pairs.good: $q = Get-Content -LiteralPath query.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'retry backoff narrow PASS once'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) on repeat three'
pairs.good: $q = Get-Content -LiteralPath query.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'once backoff fallback PASS retried'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) chained five'
throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) broad query'
pairs.good: $q = Get-Content -LiteralPath query.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'narrow fewer words PASS scoped'

pairs.bad: throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) five chained'
throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) same wording'
throw 'Missing key at ["result"] on first read'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath result.json -Raw; 'guard result field PASS checked'

pairs.bad: throw 'Missing key at ["result"] on same shape'
throw 'Missing key at ["result"] on identical repeat'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath result.json -Raw; 'change shape guard PASS reworded'

pairs.bad: throw 'web_search_exa request timed out on wide scope'
throw 'web_search_exa request timed out after long wait'
throw 'StatusCode: non 2xx status code (503 POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) no report'
pairs.good: $q = Get-Content -LiteralPath query.txt -Raw; 'RESULT retry PASS reported shape retry gaps'
